<div class="card-body">
'''Imperial Reinforcements''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">帝国軍増援部隊</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">相手の場のカードのキャラクターと宇宙船の数の合計が、自分のよりも多いとき、１フォース消費して運命数を引く。その数の分の「ストームトルーパー」または「タイ・ファイター」をロストデッキから取り戻して再使用できる。</span><ref name="jp1-face">Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Imperial-Reinforcements-video.png|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Imperial Reinforcements (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text.</ref>
<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Imperial-Reinforcements-SWCCGcards.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">帝国軍のストームトルーパーは、１個分隊８～１０名で構成されている。作戦行動を取る場合は、増援部隊から人員を補充するのが、通常の手順である。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Imperial reinforcement unit.

'''Card text:''' When the opponent has more characters and starships in play in total than you do, use 1 Force and draw destiny. You may retrieve that number of Stormtroopers or TIE fighters from the Lost Deck for reuse.

'''Lore:''' Imperial stormtrooper squads consist of eight to ten soldiers. During operations, the usual procedure is to replenish personnel from reinforcement units.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese connects Stormtroopers and TIE fighters with “or”; the English says “and/or.” The Japanese lore describes replenishing personnel from reinforcement units, while the English says reinforcements are typically held in reserve.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Reinforcements]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
